name: Auth | Authz: Bearer sai trên mọi route bảo vệ → 401 (data-driven)

data.script: const c = pm.iterationData.get('expected_code'), m = pm.iterationData.get('expected_message'); let j = {}; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {} const is = j.issue || []; if (c) { pm.test('issue code = ' + c, () => pm.expect(is.length ? is[0].code : '').to.eql(c)); } if (m) { pm.test('details.text = ' + m, () => pm.expect(is.map(i => (i.details || {}).text)).to.include(m)); }
